description: Container images referenced from tests that cannot currently be pinned to a version tag or digest. This file grants nothing: it records a known gap so scripts/check-container-images.py can stop new ones appearing. The list may only shrink.

allowed.reason: Opt-in live-Orb integration test, skipped unless Docker is available, so it never runs in CI. trustbloc/orb publishes no version tag this test has been qualified against; pinning to an unverified tag would break the developers who do run it.
PKCS#11 integration test gated behind @EnabledIfEnvironmentVariable, so it never runs in CI. The registry exposes no listable version tags, so there is nothing verifiable to pin to.
